item.title: Give Way sign and road markings unclear, 29th August
item.description:
The give way sign and road markings are not clear (markings barely visible) at the junction from The Grove pulling on to High Beeches. Cars are pulling out of The Grove without giving way, pulling into incoming traffic, or not looking in both directions, or not stopping before pulling out. Some are pulling out when they can clearly see cars driving towards them, meaning traffic driving along High Beeches have to make an emergency stop. This problem has nearly caused several accidents to those driving up or down High Beeches, who have the right of way. A much clearer sign to check traffic both ways, to not pull out into oncoming traffic and to give way, together with clearer road markings would make this junction much safer, and hopefully some drivers more respectful. Some drivers pulling out without giving way can be abusive and rude, despite the fact they are not observing the highway code and are illegally pulling out into oncoming traffic without stopping and looking at the give way junction. This has been an issue for a long time, but has become worse due to the poor signage and eroded road markings.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): The Grove, North Cray, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
